ev: The site says it is 'Family Owned | Veteran Operated' and 'Serving Science & Industry Since 1962'.
It distributes lab supplies, chemicals, reagents, calibration standards, instruments and oil and gas testing equipment.
Structured data lists 2835 Preston Ave, Pasadena, TX. The site cites five branches and Texas service areas including Dallas-Fort Worth.
Thermal Scientific, of Alvarado TX, is family-owned and veteran-operated, has absorbed General Lab Supply, and runs six Texas branches; CEO Coby Wishert is quoted.
ver: Searches found no sale or PE owner for Thermal Scientific. A July 2025 article describes it as a buyer: it folded General Lab Supply into its operations, now branded 'General Lab Supply - A Thermal Scientific Company', within a six-branch Texas network. The same article calls it family-owned and veteran-operated, serving science and industry since 1962, and quotes CEO Coby Wishert. Other results were for unrelated Thermo Fisher deals.
